title: Suspicious Milk
description: Drink at your own risk — this suspicious milk item poisons the player upon use!
body:
Suspicious Milk

Don’t drink cows’ milk... or do, if you dare.

Sus Milk adds a suspicious milk item that looks like regular milk but comes with a deadly surprise.
Features

 

🥛 Sus Milk item: Obtained by right-clicking a cow with a bucket.

☠️ When drunk, it poisons and confuses the player.

💥 Triggers a cow explosion at the nearest cow within 32 blocks — creating chaos and fun!

🎨 Added to the Food & Drinks creative tab.

✅ Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.6 and Forge

How to get Sus Milk

Simply right-click a cow with a bucket. The bucket will be replaced with Sus Milk, which you can drink for its effects — but beware of nearby cows!
Installation

    Place the .jar mod file in your .minecraft/mods/ folder.

    Launch Minecraft with Forge 1.21.x.

    Have fun… if you survive.

Notes

This mod is designed for humor and chaotic gameplay. Perfect for pranking friends or just adding a little mystery to your dairy intake.
